name: @ucos/program-compiler
description: UCOS Constitutional Program Compiler & Autonomous Execution Governor (PHASE P.1). Deterministic, fail-closed engine that compiles registry/program/*.json (single source of truth) into program state: dependency resolution, evidence-based completion, ready/blocked detection, governance-closure verdicts, gap discovery, and the system-resolved next executable work item. Regenerates the agent minimal-context and dashboard so a fresh agent resumes without repository-wide rediscovery.
